extracted.intended_audience: Highly-qualified foreign graduate, doctoral, postdoctoral students and senior scientists in Aeronautics, Space, Transportation and Energy seeking DLR-DAAD research fellowships in Germany
extracted.subtask_description: Apply for a DLR-DAAD Research Fellowship to conduct research at a DLR institute in Germany; the page specifies programme scope, eligibility, fellowship types (duration/stipend), required application documents (type-specific), language requirements, and application/award procedure. It guides applicants on what to submit and program-specific constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programme scope — host restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Within the DLR-DAAD programme, you cannot apply for a university or another institution, only for a DLR institute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowships offer research at the institutes of the DLR in Germany; applicants must identify and apply for a specific DLR institute listed in the fellowship offers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship types, duration and stipend (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships are offered in Types A–E with specific target groups, goals, funding durations and monthly instalments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type A (Graduate Student): 9 months, 992 Euros/month. Type B (Doctoral Students): 36 months, 1,760 Euros/month. Type C (Postdoctoral Researchers): 6–24 months, 2,400 Euros/month. Type D (Senior Scientists): 1–3 months, 2,760 Euros/month. Type E (Visiting Researchers PhD/Postdoc Level): 1–6 months, PhD Level 1,760 Euros / Postdoc Level 2,400 Euros. Possible additional payments vary by type (e.g., travel allowance, rent subsidy, health insurance, family allowances); some types list 'none'. Fellowships are awarded for the length of the research stay in Germany and the host DLR institute and candidate agree upon the term.

rubrics_metrics.name: General nationality eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: At the time of their application, applicants for a DLR-DAAD Fellowship must not be of German nationality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field and achievement eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must be able to prove their outstanding study or research achievements in the field of research corresponding to the fellowship offer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evidence of outstanding achievements is required as part of the application documentation (e.g., CV, publications, thesis abstracts, degree certificates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Type B recency requirement (doctoral students)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type B: have completed their studies or research with a university degree not more than six years ago.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This degree recency condition applies at time of application; specific offers may state additional prerequisites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type C recency requirement (postdoctoral researchers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type C: have completed their studies with a doctorate/PhD/Candidate (Russia) not more than two years ago.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type D eligibility (senior scientists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type D: applicants must be working in higher education or at a research institute; positions are open to outstandingly-qualified academics and scientists who should generally hold a doctorate/Ph.D.; additional prerequisites may differ and are stated in the fellowship offers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type E eligibility (visiting researchers PhD/Postdoc level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type E: PhD applicants have completed a first qualifying degree and are currently enrolled in PhD studies; Postdoc applicants must have completed their studies with a doctorate/PhD/Candidate (Russia) not more than two years ago.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language requirement — general
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have an excellent knowledge of English; knowledge of German is advantageous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some offers or types may require proof of English proficiency (see Type-specific requirements). Good English is essential for application and research communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: English language certificate minimums (Type B & C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type B & C: English language certificate required (e.g. TOEFL IBT: min. 79; IELTS: min. 6.5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upload the indicated certificate to the DAAD portal as part of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document translations
rubrics_metrics.description: German or English translation of documents submitted in the national language must be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All documents originally in another language must be translated into German or English for submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application method — DAAD online portal
rubrics_metrics.description: The application procedure occurs online through the DAAD portal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To apply, go to the DAAD scholarship database and enter the portal by clicking 'Submitting an application'. Only applications submitted via the portal with all required uploads are accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required documents — Type A (Graduate Student)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type A: The following documents have to be uploaded to the DAAD portal: Online Application form; Cover page; Statement of the reasons for applying for a certain fellowship; Complete curriculum vitae; Abstract of the final Bachelor (or equivalent) thesis; Bachelor or similar degree certificate indicating final grade(s) (may be submitted later if not yet available); German or English translation of documents submitted in the national language; All university certificates on all annual examinations with individual grade(s), incl. explanation of grading system; Proof of enrollment for Master´s programme; Proof of English proficiency; One letter of recommendation from a professor of the applicant´s home institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Degree certificate may be subsequently submitted before the grant-supported research begins if not yet available at time of application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required documents — Type B & C (Doctoral & Postdoctoral Students)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type B & C: The following documents have to be uploaded: Online application form; Cover page; Statement of the reasons for applying for a certain fellowship; Complete curriculum vitae; List of publications, if applicable; Abstract of the final Master or PhD thesis (max. 3 pages); University degree certificate indicating final grade(s) (may be submitted later if not available at time of application); English language certificate (e.g. TOEFL IBT: min. 79; IELTS: min. 6.5); German or English translation of documents submitted in the national language; All university certificates on all annual examinations with individual grade(s), incl. explanation of grading system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are not required to submit any confirmation of academic supervision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required documents — Letters of recommendation (Type A, B & C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type A: One letter of recommendation from a professor of the applicant's home institution. Type B & C: Two letters of recommendation are mandatory, written by senior academics of the applicant's own choice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form of the letter of recommendation has to be generated in the DAAD portal in the section 'Request reference' after registration and downloaded. The letter can be submitted digitally by referees via the DAAD reference database — forward the link accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required documents — Type D (Senior Scientists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type D: The following documents have to be uploaded to the DAAD portal: Online application form; Cover page; Statement of the reasons for applying for a certain fellowship; Complete curriculum vitae; List of publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required documents — Type E (Visiting Researchers PhD/Postdoc Level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type E: The following documents have to be uploaded: Online application form; Cover page; Statement of the reasons for applying for a certain fellowship; Complete curriculum vitae; All university certificates on all annual examinations with individual grade(s), incl. explanation of grading system; List of publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type E distinguishes PhD-level and Postdoc-level stipends and additional payments (PhD Level: 1,760 Euros + possible health insurance and travel allowance; Postdoc Level: 2,400 Euros, possible payments vary).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application completeness and acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Only complete applications will be accepted. Applicants are responsible for their applications’ completeness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all required uploads and forms (including translated documents and referee requests) are completed in the DAAD portal before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline and allocation principle
rubrics_metrics.description: If an application deadline exists, it is mentioned in the current offers. The DLR-DAAD scholarships are awarded with the principle 'first come first serve', therefore fellowship offers may sometimes be allocated to other applicants while your application is still processed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply early and monitor current offers; lack of a fixed deadline for some offers means timely submission is important.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consent to data forwarding
rubrics_metrics.description: By applying for a fellowship within the DLR-DAAD Research Fellowships Programme you give your consent to the DAAD to forward your documents and your personal details to DLR and its relevant institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The DAAD and the DLR will not pass on your details to third parties beyond relevant DLR institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award term agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships are always awarded for the length of the research stay in Germany. The host DLR institute and the fellowship candidate will agree upon the length of this term.
